tagline: Twin-panel file manager in your browser.
description: Krusader is a KDE orthodox file manager with archive support, FTP, search, sync, and a dual-pane workflow. This image exposes it through noVNC and a VNC server.

tips.before_install: The VNC password is `casaos`. Krusader runs privileged and can access `/DATA`, `/mnt`, and `/media`, so keep it on a trusted network. The app is amd64-only.

author: WisdomSky
